findings.title: Factory shape conversion still precedes the non-string dtype guard
findings.reproduction: python3 -B artifacts/eng2/rev2/dtype_boundaries.py: for zeros, ones, randn and rand, pass Shape([2,3]) with dtype=None, where Shape is a list subclass whose __iter__ records a call and draws once from NumPy. All four execute shape.__iter__ and advance RNG before raising the registered TypeError; zero device calls occur.
findings.argument: Lines 70-71 normalize a tuple/list shape before line 72 validates dtype. Even a plain list allocates its tuple before refusal. Ordinary integer-shape calls are fixed, but the stated before-any-conversion/allocation/random-draw guarantee is incomplete. The shape conversion is pre-existing, not a newly introduced regression; MINOR because this residual requires the shape-normalization path, and the observed RNG draw is in the supplied iterator.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the non-string dtype check ahead of shape normalization in make, retaining the registered TypeError and existing supported-dtype behavior; add a shape-iterator sentinel check.

findings.title: The all-entry census still omits RegisteredMargins.lookup
findings.reproduction: python3 -B artifacts/eng2/rev2/dtype_boundaries.py and dtype_signature_inventory.json: tensor_cuda/tensor_cuda/apa_sp2.py:53 defines RegisteredMargins.lookup(..., dtype, ...), but neither 337-row census contains it. The exact baseline and candidate method bodies both raise ValueError("apa_sp2: table covers fp32 at scale=1/sqrt(D) only") for float64, double, int32 and not_a_dtype before reading the table.
findings.argument: A1 adds all four omissions named by REV1, but the order requires every dtype-string entry under tensor_cuda/tensor_cuda. This additional public metadata-validation entry accepts a dtype string and is absent. It is a census completeness gap, not a tensor fallback or a newly introduced product defect. The refusal probe uses a table-read sentinel; it does not validate calibration data or attention execution.
findings.suggested_fix: Add RegisteredMargins.lookup to the census with its baseline and candidate refusal rows, identifying its metadata-validation role and float32-only contract; leave its product behavior unchanged.
